gaps.detail: STR roll_required/result claims have no roll or target, the first transaction narrates destruction while state remains false, and a later no-roll push performs the actual false→true state change.
Knife combat_start is intended by scenario data, but no combat start, attack, defense, damage, HP change, or combat end is executed/logged.
L1 text has SAN target/current 70, roll 40, success, and loss 0; all L2 SAN fields are null, causing placeholder overlay values.

The knife encounter supplies value=1D4, but the resolver only honors slash-form values and otherwise defaults failure to 1d3. The executed check succeeded, so this session did not expose a wrong SAN total.
L1 text explicitly changes failure to regular success with Luck 9, while L2 retains only the raw failure and no modifier relation.
All 35 normalized SKILL_CHECK records sourced from Unified Event Log lack a numeric roll and target threshold; many can only be supplemented by separate session-log records.
The special-objective lifecycle is structured, but the source provides no human-readable action/result narration. M3 currently supplies conservative grounded narration.

note: No primary PRESENTATION_GAP was found for the representative SAN case: the placeholders originate from null normalized fields.
